author: Mishra, S.R. and others
title: A measurement of the weak mixing angle from nu_mu e elastic scattering
abstract: A final measurement of the weak mixing angle from nu_mu e elastic scattering in the CHARM-II experiment. The combined result is sin^2theta_W = 0.2324 +/- 0.0058 (stat) +/- 0.0051 (syst).
